summary.headline: Celemics: Largest shareholder Park Jong-gap pledges 487,425 shares for KRW 3.5bn loan to G&M
summary.what_happened: Celemics disclosed a corrected filing on Nov 25, 2026 concerning a share pledge by largest shareholder Park Jong-gap, who provided part of his holdings as collateral for a loan taken by G&M Co., Ltd. The pledge was made on Sep 7, 2026, and the loan was refinanced from an existing borrowing, with Bluec Investment Fund now listed as creditor. The correction changed the creditor, the borrowing amount and the secured amount to KRW 3.5bn, and the pledge period runs from Sep 7, 2026 to Dec 31, 2026.

key_numbers.label: Holding if all pledged shares are disposed

summary.why_it_matters: A share pledge by a largest shareholder typically signals that shares are being used as collateral for borrowing; if the borrower defaults, the pledged shares may be sold by the creditor, which can affect the shareholding structure and share supply. Under the pledge terms, voting rights on the pledged shares remain with the pledgor during the pledge period.
